properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is ongoing.

* WHERE...Southwestern Polk County in southeastern Texas...
Central San Jacinto County in southeastern Texas...

* WHEN...Until 1015 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Low-water
crossings are inundated with water and may not be passable
especially along FM 3128 northeast of Coldspring and SH 150 west of
Shepherd.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 816 AM CDT, Flooding is already occuring in the warned area.
Between 4 and 7 inches of rain have fallen.
- Flooding impacts will continue, and monitoring approaching
scattered showers. Flash Flood Guidance is very low in this area
due to previous rounds of rainfall, especially near Coldspring.

back to a Flash Flood Warning.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Shepherd, Coldspring and Lake Livingston State Park.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

deaths occur in vehicles.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued September 3 at 6:38AM CDT until September 3 at 9:00AM CDT by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...North Central Liberty County in southeastern Texas...

* WHEN...Until 900 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Numerous roads
remain closed due to flooding including FM 943 at Menard Creek near
Segno.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 634 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Flooding is already occurring in the warned area.
Between 6 and 10 inches of rain have fallen.

rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are possible in the warned
area. If rainfall persists for an extended period of time or if
rain rates increase, this may need to be upgraded to a Flash
Flood Warning again.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Moss Hill.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

deaths occur in vehicles.

dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.description:

rainfall is expected.

* WHEN...Until 900 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas. Some
low-water crossings may become impassable.

stream flooding. Between 2 and 5 inches of rain have fallen since
